episodes.synopsis: Pro golfer Kiria crosses paths with the mischievous Gawain — who possesses an astonishing talent for golf even though he's never played the sport.
episodes.title: Encountering a Dream

episodes.synopsis: Lost in Tokyo, Gawain has a fateful meeting with a sullen young golfer, who shows him the way to Kiria's home — and a new aspect of golf.
episodes.title: The Importance of Each Stroke

episodes.synopsis: Gawain learns that making the ball fly isn't enough to become the world's best golfer. He asks Kiria to give him a crash course on putting and iron shots.
episodes.title: Twin Peaks of Talent

episodes.synopsis: With his new skills, Gawain breezes through the first half of his inaugural tournament. But how will he fare when faced with bad weather conditions?
episodes.title: First Tournament

episodes.synopsis: At Camelot Academy, Gawain meets his new classmates, gifted junior golfers from around the world. Riser, unimpressed by Gawain's size, challenges him.
episodes.title: Camelot Academy

episodes.synopsis: To debut on the golf course, Gawain must win a game against Liebel on the D-level training course. But Liebel behaves strangely during the match play.
episodes.title: Uncrowned Prince

episodes.synopsis: With the Camelot Cup coming up, tensions rise with only seven spots open. Some older schoolmates take aggressive measures to cut the competition.
episodes.title: An Explosive Situation

episodes.synopsis: On the day of the tryouts, Gawain is up against Li and Todoin in a spiral course where his usual straight drive won't help. Can he master the slice?
episodes.title: The Tryouts Begin

episodes.synopsis: Yumiko struggles with a bunker shot, while Kuromine's gift for seeing snake-like putting lines gets her ahead. Lancelot's unexpected visit causes a stir.
episodes.title: Stubbornness and Pride

episodes.synopsis: The final playoff will decide who takes the last spot. But first, Riser and Gawain need to conquer a challenging course — and Kanazono's dirty tricks.
episodes.title: Playoffs

episodes.synopsis: Gawain stumbles upon an unassuming salaryman wandering around the school grounds who turns out to be their new coach: Hitomi Katase, a former pro golfer.
episodes.title: A Venerable Visitor

episodes.synopsis: Kuromine challenges transfer student Lancelot, staking her pride as a putter and a spot on the team. The Japan team heads to England for the Camelot Cup.
episodes.title: To the Battlefield!
